name: The Clean Slate
description: An aspect of Jace as a child enduring abuse, freed by Garruk's empathy and hosted in his mind.

description_citations.text: "Garruk". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk's empathy frees the Clean Slate, an aspect of Jace as an abused child, which he hosts in his mind.
timeline.quote: He hosted the Clean Slate in his mind as the allies moved forward.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Through the next portal the group falls to a rooftop memory in the rain, with Alhammarret's body dying.
timeline.quote: At the center of it all is a gargantuan sphinx.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Garruk kneels by the young Jace, who does not know who he is, and promises to protect him; the boy vanishes into Garruk's mind as the Clean Slate.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The aberrations attack the Theorist's mind; the Warden and the Clean Slate try to stop him, but he raises a barrier of sleep.
timeline.quote: The Theorist summons a barrier of sleep behind him

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The aberrations rush into the Theorist and overtake his mind, each taking a role in subduing him.
timeline.quote: They overtake his mind like a tsunami.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.
